notes.content: art studio Upper division requirement information

The Art Studio Option has an upper division requirement that includes selecting courses from the following art studio groups: Ceramics Digital Media Drawing Glass Design Painting Photography Printmaking Sculpture The student is to select 9 units from a single art studio group (emphasis) and an additional 9 units from any art studio group. In the Art Studio Group Prerequisite Courses section below, the student should carefully select courses based on the courses the student plans to take to meet this upper division art studio requirement. Please see the University Catalog for the upper division course listings as well as the full listing of degree requirements.
notes.contentHtml:
The Art Studio Option has an upper division requirement that includes selecting courses from the following art studio groups:

  • Ceramics
  • Digital Media
  • Drawing
  • Glass Design
  • Painting
  • Photography
  • Printmaking
  • Sculpture


The student is to select 9 units from a single art studio group (emphasis) and an additional 9 units from any art studio group. In the Art Studio Group Prerequisite Courses section below, the student should carefully select courses based on the courses the student plans to take to meet this upper division art studio requirement. Please see the University Catalog for the upper division course listings as well as the full listing of degree requirements.

notes.content: Photography emphasis students must take ARTS 241 instead of ARTS 126 (in list of required courses below) and must select ARTS 240 and two other courses from the Art Studio Group Prerequisite Courses list.
